factorial.def: For a whole number n, $n! = n \times (n - 1) \times \cdots \times 2 \times 1$, the number of ways to put n different items in order. By definition $0! = 1$.

combination.def: The number of ways to choose k items from n when order does not matter: ${}_nC_k = \binom{n}{k} = \frac{n!}{k!\,(n - k)!}$, read "n choose k".
